---
title: "uv-python inline context parity"
subtitle: "YAML literal `{python} should_not_execute_yaml`"
engine: uv-python
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

This fixture exercises Quarto-style inline Python execution in document order.

```{python}
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown, HTML, Text

x = 1
state_order = ["chunk-1"]

class InlineReprMarkdownObject:
    def _repr_markdown_(self):
        return "**INLINE_REPR_MARKDOWN_SHOULD_NOT_RAW**"

    def __str__(self):
        return "INLINE_REPR_MARKDOWN_TEXT **not bold**"


class InlineReprHtmlObject:
    def _repr_html_(self):
        return '<span id="inline-repr-html-should-not-raw">INLINE_REPR_HTML_SHOULD_NOT_RAW</span>'

    def __str__(self):
        return "INLINE_REPR_HTML_TEXT <em>not html</em>"


class InlineToMarkdownObject:
    def to_markdown(self):
        return "**INLINE_TO_MARKDOWN_SHOULD_NOT_RAW**"

    def __str__(self):
        return "INLINE_TO_MARKDOWN_TEXT **not bold**"


class InlineToHtmlObject:
    def to_html(self):
        return '<span id="inline-to-html-should-not-raw">INLINE_TO_HTML_SHOULD_NOT_RAW</span>'

    def __str__(self):
        return "INLINE_TO_HTML_TEXT <em>not html</em>"


class InlineDisplayReprMarkdownObject:
    def _repr_markdown_(self):
        return "**INLINE_DISPLAY_REPR_MARKDOWN_LITERAL**"


class InlineDisplayReprHtmlObject:
    def _repr_html_(self):
        return '<span id="inline-display-repr-html-should-not-raw">INLINE_DISPLAY_REPR_HTML_LITERAL</span>'


class InlineDisplayToMarkdownObject:
    def to_markdown(self):
        return "**INLINE_DISPLAY_TO_MARKDOWN_LITERAL**"


class InlineDisplayToHtmlObject:
    def to_html(self):
        return '<span id="inline-display-to-html-should-not-raw">INLINE_DISPLAY_TO_HTML_LITERAL</span>'
```

First inline sees x=`{python} x` and records order marker `{python} state_order.append("inline-1") or len(state_order)`.

```{python}
x = 2
state_order.append("chunk-2")
```

Second inline sees x=`{python} x` and full order `{python} ",".join(state_order)`.

Plain Markdown-looking inline stays literal: `{python} "**INLINE_NOT_BOLD** <em>INLINE_NOT_HTML</em>"`.

Explicit inline Markdown wrapper renders rich output: `{python} Markdown("**INLINE_MARKDOWN_WRAPPER**")`.

Explicit inline HTML wrapper renders trusted HTML: `{python} HTML('<span id="inline-html-wrapper">INLINE_HTML_WRAPPER</span>')`.

Text wrapper remains literal: `{python} Text("**INLINE_TEXT_WRAPPER_NOT_BOLD**")`.

Rich protocol objects are plain inline text, not raw Markdown/HTML: `{python} InlineReprMarkdownObject()`, `{python} InlineReprHtmlObject()`, `{python} InlineToMarkdownObject()`, `{python} InlineToHtmlObject()`.

Inline display keeps explicit wrappers raw: `{python} display(Markdown("**INLINE_DISPLAY_MARKDOWN_WRAPPER**"))` and `{python} display(HTML('<span id="inline-display-html-wrapper">INLINE_DISPLAY_HTML_WRAPPER</span>'))`.

Inline display downgrades rich object protocols to escaped text: `{python} display(InlineDisplayReprMarkdownObject())`, `{python} display(InlineDisplayReprHtmlObject())`, `{python} display(InlineDisplayToMarkdownObject())`, `{python} display(InlineDisplayToHtmlObject())`.

Escaped double-brace inline stays literal: `{{python}} should_not_execute_inline_escape`.

Extra-backtick literal inline stays literal: `` `{python} should_not_execute_extra_backtick` ``.

~~~text
`{python} should_not_execute_tilde_fence`
~~~

    `{python} should_not_execute_indented_code`

> ```text
> `{python} should_not_execute_blockquote_backtick_fence`
> ```

> ~~~text
> `{python} should_not_execute_blockquote_tilde_fence`
> ~~~

>     `{python} should_not_execute_blockquote_indented_code`

- ```text
  `{python} should_not_execute_list_backtick_fence`
  ```

- ~~~text
  `{python} should_not_execute_list_tilde_fence`
  ~~~

-     `{python} should_not_execute_list_marker_indented_code`

-     `{python} should_not_execute_explicit_list_code_first`
      `{python} should_not_execute_explicit_list_code_second`

- list item with a continuation paragraph

    List continuation inline executes: `{python} "LIST_CONTINUATION_INLINE_EXECUTED"`.

      `{python} should_not_execute_list_continuation_indented_code`
